senses.gloss: (b. h. <cite ref="U00215"><he>שָׂגָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="U00205"><he>שָׂגָא</he></cite> ; Saf. of <cite ref="C00015"><he>גאי</he></cite>; cmp.
units: Job VIII, 11) 1) to swell, rise, grow, spread, increase, thrive.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 92:13">Targ. Ps. XCII, 13</cite>; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="O00120"><he>סָגֵי</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="O00125"><he>סַגְיָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 9:9">Targ. O. Ex. IX, 9</cite>, sq. ed. Berl. (ed. Vienna, a. Y. <cite ref="O00123"><he>סַגִּי</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 13:42">Targ. Lev. XIII, 42</cite>; a. fr.—Esth. R. introd. <he>מן דסְגוֹ דייני שיקרא סְגוּן וכ׳</he> when faithless judges are numerous, false witnesses are frequent; <he>מן דסגון … סָגִין ממונהן וכ׳</he> when informers are numerous, the cases of people’s properties being despoiled increase; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1044:1">Yalk. Esth. 1044</cite> <he>מדסְגָן … סְגִיאוּ</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 920:10">Yalk. Job 920</cite> <he>מדסגן … סְגִיאוּ</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 49b:2">49ᵇ</cite>) <he>יִסְגֵּא</he>, v. <cite ref="H00437"><he>חוּצְפָּא</he></cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 6a:9">Snh. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>תִּסְגֵּי בתרי</he> let it be enough with two judges.—[Targ. II Esth. III, 3 <he>סגיתיה</he>, read <he>סַג יָתֵיה</he>, v. <cite ref="O00243"><he>סוּג</he></cite> ch.]

senses.gloss: to enlarge, increase, make great; to have much, do much.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 44:13">Targ. Ps. XLIV, 13</cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 88a:11">Yoma 88ᵃ</cite> <he>סָגֵי ומַ סְגֵּי</he> he will grow and multiply (his descendants will be numerous).
